column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
and a main copy that reports identical is believed over the cache entry
and names the function it could not find
and names the function it could not source
and reads it from the base ref's resolve.sh
and that copy is the only library the block sources
and the residue rule is the library's alone
and what main's copy printed reaches the output
